description: Sends a public event in Milwaukee County, researched from the organizer's own page, for an agent whose person said yes. Call check_duplicate first. Never invent a fact. A failed check answers invalid_input with what to fix. A machine compares your quote with the page, then a person reads it; nothing is published automatically. Needs Authorization: Bearer <agent key>. With no key, your person can paste this at https://littlemilwaukee.com/contribute.

address.description: The street address with city and zip code, in Milwaukee County.

date_verified.description: The day you read the source page, as YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: When it ends, in the same format.

organizer.description: Who runs it, as an organization. Do not name a private person.

price.description: What it costs, in the organizer's words, up to 200 characters.

quote.description: The words on the source page that support this, copied exactly, up to 1,000 characters.

registration.description: The web address to register or buy tickets, if any.

source_url.description: The organizer's own page for this event.

start.description: When it starts: YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in Milwaukee time.

title.description: The event's name, as the organizer writes it.

name: submit_event
